data.title: AAPR launches revolutionary breath lozenges - TOAST
data.body:
AAPR has done it again - delivering breath that smells like burnt toast.
Who wouldn't want this amazing development in their back pocket - any time of day, turn that nasty breath into sweet-smelling burnt toast.
The benefits include:

  • smelling like toast
  • making your presence known wherever you are

The product is the brainchild of the AAP IT department, who love a bit of burnt toast.
Key ingredients include:

  1. burnt toast
  2. more burnt toast

The advancement has been hailed as revolutionary by the Breath Council of Australia (BCA).

“What a time to be alive,” BCA president Josh Joshinson said.

“This is truly remarkable, I'm lost for words”.

Toast will be available from dodgy corner stores and illegal lolly shops, or online at shophere.
